Sunshine Spa & Beauty Clinic is a premier beauty and wellness destination located at 74 Trần Trọng Cung, P. Tân Thuận Đông, Q.7, Ho Chi Minh City. We specialize in a variety of spa and beauty treatments designed to rejuvenate your body and enhance your natural beauty.

Our team of skilled professionals is dedicated to providing you with a personalized experience, using high-quality products and advanced techniques. Whether you're seeking relaxation or specific skincare solutions, we tailor our services to meet your unique needs.

At Sunshine Spa & Beauty Clinic, we believe that self-care is essential. Our tranquil atmosphere and attentive staff ensure that every visit is a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of daily life. Come discover why our clients trust us for their beauty and wellness needs.

We look forward to welcoming you and helping you achieve your beauty goals.
